name: SFDX Public Deployer
description: An application that will deploy an SFDX project from a public Github repo

CONSUMERKEY.description: The consumer key for the certificate-enabled Connected App used by the JWT bearer flow.

HUB_USERNAME.description: The pre-authorized Dev Hub integration username for the Connected App JWT bearer flow.

JWTKEY.description: The private key matching the certificate configured on the Connected App. No refresh token is stored.

HEROKU_API_KEY.description: Get from account settings in the UI (https://dashboard.heroku.com/account)

HEROKU_APP_NAME.description: name of your heroku app...used for review apps and one-off dyno creation
